en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a coastal fortification with massive round stone towers and crenellations. In the foreground a large tower dominates the right side, while another crenellated tower and buildings stand further along a sloping seaside promenade lined with small trees. Several men in early 20th‑century attire stand and converse in the open square at the base of the wall. Printed caption text at the top left reads "KORČULA - Kula Barbarigo". The overall style and wear suggest an old photograph reproduced as a postcard.
